claims.statement: AgeClockShift-up: on GSE142439 paired normal/treated EPIC arrays, the Horvath353 DNAm age signature decreases in treated samples relative to paired normal within each donor; this is a local age_signature-layer NameCert and does not entail cell identity, function, safety, rejuvenation, partial reprogramming, renewable maintenance, or immortality potential.

AgeClockShift-up robustness: on the frozen GSE142439 paired normal/treated EPIC arrays scored by Horvath353, support is limited to age_signature-layer directional robustness when both cell-type strata have negative mean paired DNAm age deltas and every leave-one-donor-out overall mean delta remains negative; this does not entail cell identity, function, safety, rejuvenation, partial reprogramming, renewable maintenance, or immortality potential.
